items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: I used to play with him, you know. ... Fats Pichon, we played at his place at the time.

ctx.x: I don't know his first name. Fats. Fats Pichon. Walter Pichon. Walter Pichon. Walter Pichon. Walter Pichon. Oh Walter, yeah. We called him Fats. Yeah. I used to play with him, you know. But we, we played for him at, uh, uh, uh, uh, what's his name? Uh, Beansy. Beansy. You know Beansy? Yeah, sure. Beansy. Yeah. Beansy. We, Fats, uh, Fats Pichon, we played at his place at the time. On Abbeville between, uh, I believe between... Beansy Rampo? Yeah. Beansy Rampo. What's the name of it? Yeah. It's Eli, so. Yeah. Yeah.…
Did they jam there? Yeah, man. Yes, sir.
